data: Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $2.90 for fiscal 2023, compared with a diluted loss per share of $0.27 for fiscal 2022. That is an improvement of $3.17 per share. Because the 2022 figure was negative, a percentage change isn't meaningful in the usual sense: the swing from a loss to a profit works out to roughly 1,174% against the absolute value of the 2022 figure, but that number overstates the comparison and is better described as a turnaround from loss to profit. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $30,425 million, about $30.4 billion, versus a net loss of $2,722 million in fiscal 2022.
